name: jupyter-unicode-vscode-ext
description: Type \beta and press Tab to get β, the way Jupyter notebooks do.

commands.title: Jupyter Unicode: Complete the LaTeX name at the cursor

jupyterUnicode.triggerOnBackslash.description: Open the popup as soon as a backslash is typed, rather than waiting for Tab. Off by default, since Jupyter waits for Tab.

jupyterUnicode.composeAccents.description: After inserting a combining mark, fold it into the character it modifies, so y\tilde becomes the single codepoint ỹ rather than y followed by U+0303. Turn off to match Jupyter exactly.

jupyterUnicode.languages.description: Languages to complete in outside notebook cells, where completion is always on. Add julia or latex to widen it. Markdown and plain text draw on the whole symbol table; everything else is filtered to characters legal in a Python name, as Jupyter filters it.
